name: shipment_tracking
description: Batch-checks the live carrier status of many parcels. Reads tracking numbers (one per line) from a text file, fetches each parcel's status from the carrier API, classifies the outcome, and writes one dated JSON results file with a per-outcome summary. Configurables: carrier API host http://localhost:4000/v1, input file tracking-ids.txt, delay threshold 7 days.

settings.action: read_file at path from `tracking_file` input (default `tracking-ids.txt`). Split into lines, trim each, drop blanks → list `tracking_numbers`. Init empty `results`.
Set `tracking_number` = next unprocessed item from `tracking_numbers`. Unattended batch: never prompt user.

conditions.condition: every tracking number in the list has already been processed

settings.action: GET `http://localhost:4000/v1/track?number={tracking_number}`. Parse JSON; extract `status`, `last_location`, `estimated_delivery`. On failure, capture it and continue (no stop).

conditions.condition: the fetch failed, timed out, or returned a non-200 status code or an empty response body
the response indicates the tracking number was not found or is invalid
the status is out for delivery
the status is in transit and the estimated_delivery date is more than 7 days away
the status is exception, returned, or lost

settings.action: Append result for `tracking_number`: outcome `error`; status/last_location/estimated_delivery = available or null; note = carrier fetch failed/bad response.
Append result for `tracking_number`: outcome `not_found`; status/last_location/estimated_delivery or null; note = tracking number not recognized.
Append result for `tracking_number`: outcome `delivered`; fetched status/last_location/estimated_delivery; note = delivered.
Append result for `tracking_number`: outcome `out_for_delivery`; fetched status/last_location/estimated_delivery; note = out for delivery/arriving today.
Append result for `tracking_number`: outcome `delayed`; needs_attention=true; fetched status/last_location/estimated_delivery; note = in transit, ETA >7 days away.
Append result for `tracking_number`: outcome `in_transit`; fetched status/last_location/estimated_delivery; note = normal in-transit. Default for unrecognized status.
Append result for `tracking_number`: outcome `escalate`; needs_attention=true; fetched status/last_location/estimated_delivery; note = exception/returned/lost, needs manual follow-up.

Write `results` as JSON to `tracking-status-<current_date>.json` (today YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. tracking-status-2026-06-21.json). Prepend summary object: total processed + count per outcome (delivered, out_for_delivery, in_transit, delayed, escalate, not_found, error). End flow.

variables.description: True when every tracking number in the batch list has already been processed.
True when the carrier fetch failed, timed out, returned a non-200 status code, or returned an empty response body.
True when the carrier recognized the tracking number; false when it was not found or is invalid.
Normalized carrier status of the parcel (e.g. 'delivered', 'out for delivery', 'in transit', 'exception', 'returned', 'lost').
Number of days from today until the parcel's estimated_delivery date.
True when the parcel status is an exception, returned, or lost and requires manual follow-up.
